reason: One-time $4.99, no subscription, and nothing needed to start a task is locked, so it is low risk after I have used it for a week. I would buy the whole thing once rather than three packs, mostly for the lock-screen widget.
objection: I don't want more things to manage, I want fewer. Themes, hats and soundscapes sound like extra stuff, and I would check the App Store reviews first to see if Plus is really worth it.
would_change_my_mind: If the App Store reviews said Plus was just cosmetics, or the widget was buggy, I would skip it.
